intelligence.essence: Max level gets their own affiliate army, tracked inside their membership. The army is NOT built — a citizen offering memberships or paywalls cannot yet create affiliates under their own membership. The split is settled: on a citizen's OWN memberships/paywalls the owner keeps 100% of whatever they charge — NayaNET takes no cut, charges nothing — and the owner offers their affiliates whatever percentage they choose, paid by them out of their 100%. Distinct from the NayaNET ambassador share: citizens earn 50% of NayaNET's revenue when they bring people to NayaNET. Two splits, never confused.
